question: In January 2025, the first organic fisheries cluster of India was launched in which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Sikkim**, the northeastern state of India, is known as the first state to launch an **organic fisheries cluster** in **January 2025**. 
• This initiative aligns with the vision of making Sikkim an **organic state**, a goal it achieved earlier by becoming the first fully organic state in India in **2016**. 
• The organic fisheries cluster will focus on promoting **sustainable aquaculture practices**, ensuring a balance between production and environmental conservation. 
• The project aims to enhance the livelihood of local fish farmers by offering them opportunities to cultivate fish organically, which fetches a premium price in domestic and international markets. 
• This move is expected to improve **food security**, reduce the ecological footprint of traditional aquaculture, and boost the economy of the region.
